prompt:

Asset type: hidden costume foundations for layered pixel-art animation.
Input image: the supplied 1024x1536 image is the exact edit target, a 4-column by 4-row grid of sixteen different CODE poses. Keep the grid, each pose, each figure's exact scale, foot position, arms, legs, laptop, tablet, stool and desk.

Replace ONLY the clothing that was concealed by that hair with the correctly shaped underlying purple hoodie, black top, sleeves, collar and back. Keep a very short cropped purple hairstyle on the same head if necessary. The underlying garment must have its actual anatomical shoulder and waist outline, without hair-shaped panels: no cape, no fabric walls in the former ponytail silhouette.
Style: preserve the source's crisp shaded pixel art, adult proportions and existing purple/black wardrobe. Draw believable hoodie folds, seam edges and volume consistent with the existing clothing's highlights and shadows.
Composition: the same sixteen figures in the same fixed 256x384 cells. Row1: three-quarter left, left profile, back three-quarter, seated laptop. Row2: four existing dance poses. Row3: right three-quarter, right profile, full back, wide walking stride. Row4: passing walking step, kneeling laptop, leaning at desk, seated typing at desk.
Constraints: Preserve every pose and all visible clothing, hands, props and footwear; change only hair removal and reconstruct the genuinely hidden costume. No anatomy changes. No props added. Do not broaden the body to match the former hair silhouette. For full back, expose a natural hoodie back between the shoulders and waist. Transparent RGBA background; no black or white matte, no checkerboard drawn into pixels, no grid borders, labels or text.
